# Private Investigator Manhattan
# https://www.privateinvestigatormanhattan.com

## About This Site

Private Investigator Manhattan is a referral and matching service that
connects clients with New York State-licensed private investigators
serving Manhattan. We are not the investigators ourselves — we vet
licensed specialists, match clients to investigators by case type,
and step back once the introduction is made.

We are not a law firm. Investigators in our network operate under
their own NYS Article 7 General Business Law licenses and engage
clients directly under their standard service agreements.

## What We Do

- Match Manhattan clients with NYS-licensed private investigators
- Vet investigators on qualifications, insurance, professional
  background, and case-type specialization before any match
- Cover every Manhattan neighborhood with on-the-ground investigators
- Provide a confidential, no-obligation consultation request

## Services Covered

- Infidelity investigations
- Surveillance (foot, multi-agent, urban specialist)
- Background checks (pre-employment, business partner, tenant)
- Corporate investigations (employee misconduct, IP theft, fraud)
- Asset searches (divorce, civil judgments, business disputes)
- Child custody investigations (parental fitness, lifestyle, court-ready evidence)

## Coverage Area

Every Manhattan neighborhood from the Financial District and Tribeca
to Midtown, the Upper East and West Sides, Harlem, and Washington
Heights. Investigators are NYS-licensed and regularly work cases
across all five NYC boroughs where matters extend beyond Manhattan.

## Legal Framework

- All investigators hold current NYS licenses under Article 7 of the
  General Business Law
- Evidence is gathered in compliance with New York privacy law and
  the Federal Wiretapping Act
- Reports are documented with chain of custody and structured for
  court admissibility
- Confidential consultation; no information is shared with third
  parties outside the matched investigator

## Pricing

Manhattan PI rates typically run $95-$250 per hour depending on
specialist experience and case complexity. Most cases require a
retainer of $1,500-$5,000. Corporate and high-asset matters command
higher rates. We provide a realistic cost estimate before introduction.
